entries.en: to delay, put off; to defer payment (Sp. mal pagador, 'bad payer')
entries.notes: 西语栏“franpottos malpagador”疑为缺损连写（仅 mal pagador“赖账者”可辨），“拖延/拖欠”义系据汉字“延”与该词头推断。

entries.zh: 字面“抱狗皮”，不成今词；疑喻死赖缠账，释义存疑
entries.en: lit. 'to hug the dog-skin' — sense uncertain; prob. 'to cling shamelessly / dodge payment'
entries.notes: 四栏不合：西栏同上缺损，“抱狗皮”不成词，仅据同组 mal pagador 语境推测，义未定夺。

entries.zh: 巷深狗怯：僻巷之犬胆怯（谚语式条目，喻义存疑）
entries.en: proverb: 'deep lane, timid dog' (lit.) — sense uncertain
entries.notes: 四字谚语式条目，西栏与上两条同缺损，喻义无定说。

entries.zh: 门闩，窗闩（闩门窗用的横木）；关
entries.en: bar or bolt (of a door or window); to shut fast
entries.notes: “Franca de puerta o ventana”疑即 tranca（闩门窗之横木）之形近读；音写 pag 与字“関”对音尚待考。

entries.zh: 悯，忧恤（据字面“閔”）；音写不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to pity, grieve (per char. 閔) — sense otherwise undetermined
entries.notes: 字“閔”与两音节音写“cuan Lua”不合，西栏仅存“franca”，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 闸，闸门（拦水、拦道之栅门）；闩住
entries.en: sluice-gate, floodgate; barrier; to bar, bolt

entries.notes: 西栏仅残“franca .”；音写 fui 与“門”mui 有 f/m 之异，或系抄写变体。

entries.zh: 门闸，门闩；闩门（关死门户）
entries.en: to bar the door (Sp. trancar la puerta); door-bar

entries.zh: 闩门（西栏与上条同）；字“門帶”与音写不合
entries.en: to bar the door (as above); Chinese and Hokkien columns discordant
entries.notes: 西栏与上条同为 francar la puerta（闩门）；汉字“門帶”、音写 kî-tsoà 与上条“門閘/muî-tsoà”出入，疑抄异，义据西栏。

entries.zh: 杠，杠棒；搬运夫抬物用的杠杆、抬杠
entries.en: bar, lever; porter's carrying-pole (Sp. palanca de cargadores)

entries.zh: 裁，裁切（布帛）；或为“裁刀”之省
entries.en: to cut (cloth, as a tailor); head of 'cutting-knife' (Sp. tranchete)
entries.notes: “Franchete”疑即 tranchete（17 世纪马尼拉语“大刀/裁刀”）；单字“裁”或为下条“裁刀”省写。

entries.en: to wipe off, clean (the table); to swab down

entries.zh: 捐，捐献（财物）（据字面；存疑）
entries.en: to donate, contribute (uncertain: M column 'hiang' unexplained)
entries.notes: 音写 hiang 与字“捐”对不上，西栏 trazegar 难解，义暂据汉字。

entries.en: to put together in one place; to consolidate (Sp. trasegar de una parte a otra, 'to pass from one side to the other')
entries.notes: 西栏“adra”疑为“a otra”之连写；“并置”义据汉字与西栏语境。

entries.zh: 捐凑起来，把（钱物）凑集一处；一说字为“藏起来”（收存），存疑
entries.en: to pool/collect together (contributions); (alt. reading of M) to put away, store
entries.notes: 字“捐起来”与音写 tsiâng-khì-lâi 有“捐/藏”两读之歧，西栏难解，义未定夺。

entries.zh: 平，齐平（据字与音写）；与西语“生前移转”义不合，存疑
entries.en: flat, level (per Chinese); Sp. 'trasladar con vida' ('to transfer during one's lifetime') unresolved
entries.notes: 字“平”（与音写一致）与西语 trasladar con vida 不侔，语义无法定夺。
